results.name: Persona-Story Alignment
results.reasoning: All user stories in the generated document correctly match their persona roles: Cloud Infrastructure Admin handles encryption/key rotation/CLI config/backend selection (infrastructure ops), Tenant Admin handles org-scoped secret management and tenant isolation (org config), and Tenant User handles self-service credential retrieval; no misattributed sanitization stories or internal system stories exist.
quotes: Cloud Infrastructure Admin, I want secrets encrypted at rest
Tenant Admin, I want to create, update, and delete secrets scoped to my organization
Tenant User, I want to retrieve cluster kubeconfigs

results.name: In Scope / Out of Scope Accuracy
results.reasoning: The generated document's In Scope section differs fundamentally from the gold standard — it omits major gold In Scope items (installation, E2E testing, documentation, automatic secret creation during provisioning, tenant-scoped privilege isolation, service scope across BMaaS/CaaS/VMaaS/MaaS/Enclave) and adds items not in gold (SecretClass resource, envelope encryption details, CLI key config, OPA policies). The Out of Scope section incorrectly includes external secret manager integration and SSH key injection as out of scope items, while the gold explicitly includes a Vault-compatible store as In Scope (installation prerequisite), making this a direct contradiction.
quotes: Installation — cloud provider must deploy and configure a Vault-compatible secret store as a prerequisite
External secret manager integration (e.g., HashiCorp Vault) — deferred to a future enhancement
E2E testing — secret CRUD, automatic secret creation during provisioning, and tenant isolation require coverage
